preconditions.description: The grid is an N x N matrix with dimensions between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= cell <= 1 for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains either 0 (water) or 1 (land).

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if not any(1 in row for row in grid) else max(max(abs(x - i) + abs(y - j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, cell in enumerate(row) if cell == 1) for x, y in [(i, j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0]))] if grid[i][j] == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum Manhattan distance from any water cell to the nearest land cell, or -1 if there are no land cells.
